data.description:
Audit the running UI against BRANDING.md and the reference demo, and fix every deviation that is a frontend bug rather than a design change. Design: BRANDING.md in full, with special attention to §2.2 (the five oxblood jobs), §3.3 (type rules), §4 (shell and breakpoints), §5 (every component), §6 (motion), §7 (copy and formatting), §8 (don'ts). Reference: docs/branding-demo.html. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §13 for known engineering deltas.

Why: three component tasks and a wiring task were built in parallel by different agents; this pass is the one place the whole surface is checked as one system by fresh eyes before the README and packaging.

Scope:
- With api and web running, compare each component to the demo at a width above 760px and at or below 760px.
- Checklist, each recorded pass or fixed in a task comment: oxblood appears only in the five §2.2 jobs; no radius except the rank pill; no shadows, gradients, translucency, icons, images; Bodoni never below 18px; tabular figures where digits sit in columns; uppercase only in labels and the wordmark; every §7.2 string verbatim; every §7.1 format; the document never scrolls; pinned header, filter bar, status line and pager; loading line is the only animation and is static under reduced motion; disabled looks use ink-3 and stone, not opacity; keyboard-only pass through search, pagination and Try again; `grep -rP "[\x{1F300}-\x{1FAFF}\x{2600}-\x{27BF}]"` over the repo finds nothing.
- Fix small CSS, markup and copy deviations in place. Anything that would require changing BRANDING.md itself (for example the Status field row, SPEC §13.1) is not changed here: raise it with `lattice needs-human` naming the section.

Acceptance:
- A checklist comment on the task listing every BRANDING section with pass or fixed.
- Screenshots at both breakpoints for the default search, the no-results state, the invalid-input state and the error state, attached to the task.
- `make check` still green.

Validation: the screenshots and the keyboard pass are the evidence; attach with --role validation.
data.title: Branding conformance pass: audit UI against BRANDING.md and the demo, fix deviations

data.body:
From BC-10 (review + validation), polish candidates for the branding pass, none blocking:
1. docs/branding-demo.html has no <meta charset>; opened as file:// the ' · ' separators render as 'Â·' (fine over HTTP). Branding owner's file (BRANDING 9 process).
2. At 375px the card meta line can break inside an item (e.g. '980 / sqft'), same as the demo; a no-break space inside each meta item would keep items whole. BRANDING is silent.
3. Text-button recipe exists in two textual forms: NoResults/ErrorState .action use 'font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-ui)' (R1 recipe verbatim), Pager uses --text-button/--leading-button tokens; identical computed values. Pick one form or hoist a shared class. BC-9's .clear still carries --tracking-button and an :active colour per BC-10's implementer (unverified by BC-10).
4. Monogram height is a literal 54px next to var(--monogram-width); calc(var(--monogram-width) * 3 / 4) would tie the 4:3 ratio to the token.
5. Open D1: at <=760px the demo shrinks the monogram (56x42 at 20px) and type and puts the price after the description; BC-10 follows BRANDING text (72x54, same sizes, price block under the meta line). Reconcile demo vs BRANDING via BRANDING 9 if the demo was intended.

From BC-12 plan review (handed over for the branding/a11y pass): (a) during a page-change load the StatusLine still reads the previous 'Page 1 of N' while the Pager already marks the clicked page (one request long; SearchPage feeds Pager the URL page). (b) SearchPage's results <main> is aria-live=polite + aria-busy (so NoResults/ErrorState are announced); ListingList's <section> is also aria-live=polite, giving nested polite regions. Consider dropping aria-live from ListingList's section. (c) BRANDING §5.9 'first load = status line alone' vs SPEC §7.5 LoadingLine active while loading: BC-12 keeps the LoadingLine on during the first load.

From BC-12 validation (art_01M4WC9P46N4142PWSVQ1JMF0J, item 7): when the results region scrolls, cards cut off flush against the StatusLine row with no divider or fade. Check against BRANDING §4.2 / the demo whether the status row should carry a hairline or the scroller a top fade.

From BC-12 implementation: frontend/src/components/FilterBar/FilterBar.module.css has a comment calling the bar 'a direct child of the shell'; since BC-12 it sits inside SearchPage's unstyled row-2 wrapper (with LoadingLine). Comment-only fix, left untouched by BC-12 (component files were out of scope).

data.reason: Need: branding owner decision on BRANDING §5.2/§4.4/§7.2 Status row (O1), §5.6 score name + rank (O2-O3), §5.3/§10 newest-first (O4), §7.2 min/max copy (O5), §2.2 loading segment as a sixth oxblood job (O6), §5.9 loading line on first load (O7), demo <=760 CSS vs §2.4/§5.5 (O8), demo file charset/doctype (O9), §3.2/§3.3/§5.8 text-button tracking + page-number weight (O10-O11, BC-19), §2.2 job 3 ring on the focusable results region (O12), §7.2 strings beyond the list (O13), §4.2/§4.4 pinned chrome on short viewports + status-row hairline (O14). Non-blocking: build follows BRANDING text; details in plan §4 + Resolutions.

data.body: Plan-review triage (art_01M4WDQP79JFKTS1PVSDWKGBMY, fable, PASS-WITH-NITS): all 11 findings obvious, applied in the plan's 'Plan-Review Cycle 1 Resolutions' R1-R10. Added D7 (FilterBar comment) and S9 (flush cut-off under the status line matches demo + §4.2; hairline question folded into O14) for the two BC-12 handovers of 04:57Z. A3/C1 now record D1's ring as owner question O12. V6 keyboard steps corrected (Clear before pets; log tabindex + outline colour since Chrome makes scrollers tabbable by default). C14 uses a perl command (macOS grep has no -P); emoji acceptance scoped to shipped files, .lattice/ records (vitest U+2713) are immutable and excluded from dist (SPEC §12). No evolutionary findings. Owner questions O1-O14 raised as one needs-human; none blocks D1-D7.

Orchestrator ruling 05:22Z (mail 01M4WDSDJ4DNRKDDRNESR2A2AK): emoji check C14 is scoped to shipped files (git ls-files minus .lattice/, the two PDFs and anything SPEC §12 excludes from the zip). Validation-plan row 4 aligned by the Orchestrator.

SPEC edit (deviation rule): §7.6 gains 'The results region is focusable (tabindex="0") so the keyboard can scroll it.' Reason: in WebKit, Tab skipped the only scroller (no focusable descendants), so keyboard-only users could not scroll page 1 past the visible cards (D1, commit 1543178). The ring's look is owner question O12, not in SPEC.

Code review routing (PASS-WITH-NITS @ 10133f8, all three nits carry 'Recommendation: none'): (1) text-button hover-guard textual difference: skipped, no computed difference and pre-existing outside D4; belongs to BC-19 if the recipe changes. (2) D3 no overflow fallback for a long unbreakable meta item: skipped, seed data fits with ~120px to spare at 375 and the plan chose this approach; validator V4(k) checks it. (3) commit subject length 87-91 chars: skipped, no length rule and history is never amended. No fix commit, so the review names HEAD; advancing to in_validation.

BC-14 BRANDING conformance checklist @ 10133f8

Validator agent:opus-5.5-validator, HEAD 10133f83f5eb6fdb034280a4e80aea413f8e6854. Runtime results come from headless Chrome 155 at 1280x800 and 375x812 (DPR 2), trusted keys and mouse over CDP. Evidence: art_01M4WF7QGZ00YPVXSFZ5E4N5FT (Validation 10133f8), art_01M4WF7QMHFTQ7CDC2RB9D7D5Q (keyboard transcript), screenshots attached with --role validation. Overall: PASS.

BRANDING sections
- §0 What was decided: pass. Runtime: light only, Bodoni Moda + Figtree loaded, oxblood accent, list cards with city monogram, rank pill + 2-decimal score, hairlines, "Brillio Listings" wordmark, pinned shell at both widths.
- §1 Principles: pass. Runtime: Bodoni only on address (22px), price (28px), monogram (26px) and the two state headings (22px italic); all other text Figtree.
- §2.1 Tokens: pass (tokens.css matches §2.1 byte for byte; no other hex values, no inline style).
- §2.2 Where oxblood appears: fixed (D1, D5); pass, owner questions O6 and O12. In words: D1 adds an oxblood focus ring on the results region (2px, inset at offset -2px, shown only on :focus-visible), a placement beyond job 3's "buttons and links", pending owner question O12. The loading segment is oxblood by §5.9 and §6 but is not one of the five jobs (O6); D5 corrected the code comment that called it a §2.2 job. Runtime census (idle, invalid, held loading, no results, error, keyboard focus; both widths): only the Search fill, text buttons, field focus underlines and button rings, invalid underlines and message, and the current page; plus the segment while loading and the D1 ring on keyboard focus. Never on price, address, rank, score, monogram, status label or hairline. A mouse click in the results shows no ring.
- §2.3 Semantic color: pass. Runtime: no green, amber or red anywhere; the error state is an ink heading with an oxblood Try again.
- §2.4 Contrast: pass, owner question O8 (demo shrinks the monogram to 20px at <=760). Runtime: monogram stays 26px at 375; placeholders ink-2.
- §2.5 Dark mode: pass (color-scheme light; no prefers-color-scheme rule).
- §3.1 Faces: pass. Runtime: document.fonts.check true for every face in use (Bodoni 400, 500, 400 italic; Figtree 400, 500, 600).
- §3.2 Scale: pass, owner questions O10 and O11. Runtime: price 28px/500, address 22px/400, monogram 26px, state heading 22/26 400 italic, text buttons 13px/13px/500/normal tracking.
- §3.3 Rules: pass, owner question O10. Runtime: smallest Bodoni 22px; uppercase only on the wordmark, the scope label, the seven field labels and the card status label (PENDING).
- §4.1 Grid: pass. Runtime: content column 1040px centred at 1280 (inline pad 120px), 16px gutter at 375.
- §4.2 App shell: fixed (D1); owner question O14. Runtime: at 1280x800 and 375x812 the document never scrolls (scrollHeight == innerHeight, scrollY 0 after scrolling the results to the bottom); header, bar, status and pager rects unchanged; the results region is the only scroller and the keyboard now reaches and scrolls it (PageDown 0 -> 457). O14 measured: chrome 504px at 375 wide; 375x667 leaves a 163px results region; 667x375 leaves 0px and keyboard focus scrolls the overflow-hidden body by up to 129px.
- §4.3 Radius and elevation: fixed (D6). Runtime: non-zero radius only on the rank pills (999px); no shadow, gradient, filter, backdrop-filter or opacity below 1; html -webkit-tap-highlight-color rgba(0, 0, 0, 0).
- §4.4 Breakpoints: pass, owner question O1. Runtime: >760 seven fields on row one and Search + Clear on row two (O1), Clear ending exactly at its 131px column edge (no overflow); <=760 two columns, actions on their own row with Search flex:1 beside Clear (as the demo), price block under the meta line, left-aligned, price before rank.
- §4.5 Alignment: pass. Runtime: price block right-aligned at >760, page numbers centred, labels above values.
- §5.1 Header: pass. Runtime: 56px with hairline at both widths; wordmark h1 and scope label.
- §5.2 Filter bar: pass, fixed (D7, comment only), owner question O1. Runtime: focus is a 2px oxblood underline with no ring; Min 500000 then Max 400000 marks both fields, one message under Max price, Search disabled, and no request reached the API (log count unchanged).
- §5.3 Status line: pass, owner question O4. Runtime: "12 results · newest first" / "Page 1 of 2"; "12 results · ranked for $450,000"; "0 results" / empty; "Loading" while a search is held; both halves empty on error.
- §5.4 Listing card: fixed (D3). Runtime at 375: every meta line wraps only after a dot; 0 items split, 0 overflow.
- §5.5 Monogram: pass, owner question O8. Runtime: 26px Bodoni in a stone block at both widths.
- §5.6 Score: pass, owner questions O2 and O3. Runtime: 999px pills, score to two decimals, page 2 begins at No. 11.
- §5.7 Pager: pass, owner question O11. Runtime: 48px; current page has aria-current="page", oxblood, 500, 1px underline; disabled ends use the disabled attribute, ink-3, and leave the Tab order.
- §5.8 Buttons: fixed (D4). Runtime V5: Clear, Clear filters, Try again, Previous, Next and a non-current page number compute identically (13px, line-height 13px, 500, normal tracking, oxblood, no padding, pointer; hover underline at 3px offset; focus ring 2px oxblood at 3px offset). Search: oxblood fill, ring at 2px offset, disabled stone with ink-3 text.
- §5.9 States: fixed (D2), owner question O7. Runtime: loading keeps the list and "Page N of M", Search disabled, segment 40% wide at 1.2s linear; no results centred 96px from the top with verbatim copy; invalid verbatim; error shows the heading and Try again, status empty, the failure only in the console. One live region (main).
- §5.10 Icons: pass. Runtime: no img, svg or canvas; the only glyphs are ‹ › ▾, set as text.
- §6 Motion: pass. Runtime: getAnimations() empty when idle; only the segment's slide while a search is held; under prefers-reduced-motion empty and the segment full width (1280 of 1280, 375 of 375).
- §7 Copy: pass (sentence case, no exclamation marks, "please" or apologies).
- §7.1 Formatting: pass. Runtime samples: $470,000; 3 bd · 2 ba · 1,300 sqft · Listed Sep 4 · MLS A; 0.40; No. 1.
- §7.2 Strings: pass, owner questions O5 and O13. Runtime: No results. / Adjust your filters. / Clear filters / Couldn't load results. / Try again / Min price must be less than max price. / Loading, all verbatim.
- §8 Don'ts: fixed (D6). Runtime: no spinners, skeletons, toasts, modals, zebra striping, shadows, images or relative dates; the translucent tap flash is gone.
- §9 Change process: n/a (BRANDING.md and docs/branding-demo.html untouched by this branch; O1-O14 raised as needs-human).
- §10 Open decisions: pass, owner question O4. Static: both sources shown and labelled. Runtime: pinned shell, Figtree wordmark, inert cards (no Tab stop inside any card), newest first with no budget.

Ticket checklist
- C1 Oxblood only in the five §2.2 jobs: fixed (D1, D5); pass, owner questions O6 and O12. D1 adds an oxblood focus ring on the results region, pending O12; the loading segment is O6. Runtime census as under §2.2.
- C2 No radius except the rank pill: pass, fixed (D6). Runtime: only the rank pills.
- C3 No shadows, gradients, translucency, icons, images: pass, fixed (D6). Runtime: zero hits; tap highlight transparent.
- C4 Bodoni never below 18px: pass. Runtime: minimum 22px.
- C5 Tabular figures where digits sit in columns: pass (static audit A9).
- C6 Uppercase only in labels and the wordmark: pass. Runtime: wordmark, scope label, field labels and the card status label only.
- C7 Every §7.2 string verbatim: pass, owner questions O5 and O13.
- C8 Every §7.1 format: pass (unit-tested formatters; runtime samples under §7.1).
- C9 The document never scrolls: pass at 1280x800 and 375x812 (runtime oracle a); owner question O14 for short viewports (at 667x375 keyboard focus scrolls the body by up to 129px).
- C10 Pinned header, filter bar, status line and pager: pass. Runtime: rects unchanged while the results scroll.
- C11 Loading line is the only animation and static under reduced motion: pass. Runtime oracle h at both widths.
- C12 Disabled looks use ink-3 and stone, not opacity: pass. Runtime: disabled Search rgb(232, 231, 225) fill, rgb(163, 161, 154) text, opacity 1; no element below opacity 1.
- C13 Keyboard-only pass: fixed (D1). Runtime V6: search, pagination, Clear and Try again by trusted keys, 10 of 10 checks pass; results stop is MAIN with tabindex 0 and the oxblood ring; WebKit path proven by SearchPage test T13.
- C14 Emoji grep: pass for shipped files. Command: git ls-files -z | grep -zv '^\.lattice/' | grep -zv '\.pdf$' | grep -zv '\.db$' | grep -zv 'node_modules/' | xargs -0 perl -CSD -ne 'print "$ARGV:$.\n" if /[\x{1F300}-\x{1FAFF}\x{2600}-\x{27BF}]/; close ARGV if eof'. Result: no hits in 132 shipped files. No hits outside .lattice/; inside it, U+2713 (724) in 9 vitest/validation logs plus binary noise in 44 PNGs (immutable records, not shipped, SPEC §12).
